title: PortalPeek
description: Automatically shows Nether/Overworld coordinate conversions on your HUD. Never do portal math again.
body:
# PortalPeek

**PortalPeek** is a lightweight, client-side Minecraft mod that takes the math out of Nether portal linking. It renders a clean HUD overlay showing your corresponding coordinates in the opposite dimension — so your portal links are always perfectly aligned.

Since it is entirely client-side, you can use it on any multiplayer server, realm, or singleplayer world without requiring any server-side installation.

---

## Features

- **Instant Coordinate Conversion** — Displays your converted Nether coordinates when in the Overworld (divided by 8), and your converted Overworld coordinates when in the Nether (multiplied by 8).
- **Clean HUD Overlay** — Semi-transparent background with drop shadows for high contrast, readable on any texture pack or background.
- **Proximity Mode** — Only shows the HUD when you are within 5 blocks of a Nether Portal, keeping your screen clutter-free.
- **Quick-Toggle Hotkey** — Press **H** (rebindable in Controls) to instantly toggle the HUD overlay.
- **In-Game Configuration** — Full Cloth Config and ModMenu integration. Adjust HUD scale, position, and toggle settings without leaving the game.
- **Command Support** — Full slash and dot-command support for flexibility on any server.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/portalpeek toggle` | Toggle the HUD on or off |
| `/portalpeek proximity [true/false]` | Toggle proximity mode |
| `/portalpeek pos <x> <y>` | Set custom HUD position |
| `/portalpeek scale <value>` | Set HUD scale (0.2 to 5.0) |

Dot-prefix support is also available — type `.portalpeek toggle` in chat to run commands client-side without sending anything to the server chat.

---

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| **Platform** | Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ |
| **Side** | Client-side only |
| **Java** | Java 21+ |
| **Required** | Fabric API, Cloth Config API |
| **Recommended** | ModMenu — required for the in-game settings screen. The mod may behave unexpectedly without it. |

*Client-side only — works on any server.*

---
